title: Sausage & egg breakfast muffin
method: Split the sausages lengthways, remove the skins if needed and press the meat into two thin patties.
Heat a non-stick frying pan with half the oil and cook the sausage patties for 4–5 minutes each side until completely cooked through.
Toast the muffin while the sausages cook, then wilt the spinach briefly in the pan.
Add the remaining oil, fry the egg until the white is set, then stack the muffin with spinach, tomato, sausage and egg.

substitutions.note: Use a product suitable for your dietary needs and cook according to its pack instructions.
Use an equivalent bread portion and check allergen labelling.

storage.chilled: Best eaten fresh. Cooked sausage can be cooled promptly and refrigerated for up to 2 days.
storage.reheat: Reheat cooked sausage once until steaming hot throughout; cook the egg fresh for best quality.

food_safety: Cook sausage meat thoroughly with no pink remaining in the centre.
Keep raw sausage separate from ready-to-eat ingredients and wash hands and utensils after handling it.

title: Banana & peanut butter porridge
method: Add the oats and milk to a saucepan and bring gently to a simmer.
Cook for 4–5 minutes, stirring regularly, until thick and creamy.
Slice the banana and stir half through the porridge with the cinnamon.
Spoon into a bowl and top with the remaining banana and measured peanut butter.

substitutions.note: Choose a product suitable for your allergy requirements and use the same measured portion.
Check allergen labelling and choose one appropriate to your dietary needs.

storage.chilled: Best eaten immediately. If prepared ahead, cool promptly and refrigerate for up to 24 hours.
storage.reheat: Reheat once until steaming hot, adding a splash of milk if needed.

food_safety: Keep milk refrigerated until use and cool any leftovers promptly.

title: Chicken pesto pasta pot
method: Cook the pasta according to the packet instructions until tender, then drain and cool under cold running water.
Mix the pesto with the Greek yoghurt to make a lighter dressing.
Add the cooled pasta, cooked chicken, tomatoes and spinach to a lunch container.
Stir through the pesto dressing, cover and keep chilled until eating.

substitutions.note: Use an equivalent cooked portion and keep chilled.
Choose a product suitable for your allergy requirements and check its label.

storage.chilled: Cool the pasta promptly, refrigerate the assembled pot and eat within 24 hours.
storage.reheat: Designed to be eaten cold; do not repeatedly warm and chill cooked chicken.

food_safety: Use safely cooked and chilled chicken within its use-by period.
Cool cooked pasta promptly before combining with chilled ingredients.

title: Tuna & sweetcorn jacket potato
method: Prick the potato several times with a fork and microwave on high for 8–12 minutes, turning halfway, until soft throughout.
Drain the tuna and sweetcorn well, then mix with the yoghurt, mustard and black pepper.
Split the hot potato and fluff the inside with a fork.
Spoon over the tuna mixture and serve with the salad leaves.

substitutions.note: Use an equivalent cooked portion and keep chilled before use.
Check allergen labelling and use a measured portion.

storage.chilled: Best assembled fresh. Refrigerate unused tuna mixture promptly and eat within 24 hours.
storage.reheat: Reheat only the plain cooked potato until steaming hot; add chilled tuna mixture afterwards.

food_safety: Refrigerate opened tuna promptly and do not leave the tuna mixture at room temperature for extended periods.

title: Turkey meatball tomato pasta
method: Mix the turkey mince with the egg, breadcrumbs and half the oregano, then shape into 16 small meatballs.
Heat the oil in a large frying pan and brown the meatballs for 6–8 minutes, turning carefully, then set aside.
Cook the onion for 5 minutes, add the garlic, tomatoes and remaining oregano, then return the meatballs and simmer for 15 minutes until completely cooked through.
Meanwhile cook the spaghetti according to the packet instructions, drain and divide between four bowls.
Spoon over the meatballs and tomato sauce and serve immediately.

substitutions.note: Cook thoroughly and keep the same total quantity.
Choose a suitable product and follow its pack cooking instructions.

storage.chilled: Cool leftovers promptly, cover and refrigerate for up to 2 days.
storage.freeze: Freeze cooled sauce and meatballs in individual portions.
storage.reheat: Defrost safely if frozen and reheat until steaming hot throughout; only reheat once.

food_safety: Cook turkey meatballs completely through with no pink remaining.
Wash hands and utensils after handling raw mince and egg.

title: Chicken saag with basmati rice
method: Cook the basmati rice according to the packet instructions.
Heat the oil in a deep frying pan and cook the onion for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and cook for 5 minutes, stirring, then add the tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes until the chicken is completely cooked through.
Add the spinach in handfuls until wilted, remove the pan from the heat and stir through the yoghurt.
Serve the chicken saag with the cooked rice.

substitutions.note: Use a suitable tofu and cook until hot throughout; check allergen labelling.
Choose an option suitable for your dietary needs and stir in off the heat.

storage.chilled: Cool leftovers promptly and refrigerate for up to 2 days.
storage.reheat: Reheat curry once until steaming hot throughout. Cool cooked rice quickly, refrigerate promptly and reheat only once.

food_safety: Cook chicken completely through before serving.
Handle cooked rice carefully: cool quickly, refrigerate promptly and reheat only once.

title: Cottage cheese & pineapple pot
method: Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl or lidded pot.
Drain the pineapple thoroughly and add it on top.
Sprinkle over the pumpkin seeds and cinnamon.
Eat immediately or cover and keep chilled until needed.

storage.chilled: Keep covered in the fridge and eat within 24 hours.

food_safety: Keep cottage cheese refrigerated and use within its use-by period.

title: Apple & peanut butter crunch
method: Wash, core and slice the apple into wedges.
Measure the peanut butter into a small bowl or pot.
Sprinkle the apple with cinnamon and pumpkin seeds.
Dip the apple slices into the measured peanut butter as you eat.

substitutions.note: Choose a product suitable for your allergy requirements.

storage.chilled: Best eaten soon after slicing; refrigerate prepared apple if not eating immediately.

food_safety: Use a clean knife and board for preparing the fruit and keep nut products away from anyone with a relevant allergy.
